observation.visible_scene: A performer viewed from behind stands on an outdoor festival stage beneath a tensile canopy lit in blue, holding a long fire staff with flames burning at both ends. A dense crowd with raised hands and phone lights fills the background. Monitors, speaker stacks and cables line the stage floor.
visible_changes: The staff begins held horizontally across the performer's upper back/shoulders, both ends flaming, while she stands nearly upright.
The staff tilts and rotates: the right end swings downward and the left end upward, moving through a diagonal orientation toward a near-vertical position overhead.

The performer's torso and hips turn, her stance widens and knees bend as she spins the staff around her body and then overhead, the body shifting from a square back-to-camera pose to a more angled, crouched pose.
Flame plumes at both staff ends trace arcing trails through the air as the ends sweep past the head and shoulders.
The performer's position in the frame drifts slightly rightward and her body profile changes as the rotation progresses.
outside_clip_unknowns: What preceded the horizontal hold and what follows the overhead spin are not shown.
Whether the staff rotation continues, reverses or stops after the last frame is unknown.
uncertain_details: Minor apparent framing drift (slight pan/zoom) is hard to separate from the performer's own movement.
Exact hand grip changes during the spin are obscured by the body and flames.
